# The Lantern Keeper

Ivo hurt his ankle in a storm. Mara had to light the harbour lantern.

Rusk told Mara to leave it dark. He wanted another ship to miss the tide. He threatened Mara's apprenticeship.

Mara was scared, but ships needed the light to avoid Black Tooth Reef.

She climbed the tower and lit the lantern. The Gull Star saw it and sailed safely past the reef.

Mara told Ivo about Rusk. The council took away Rusk's power over apprenticeship papers while it investigated him.
